## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `buildcontexthtml` command packages a directory (or multiple directories/files) into a single, self-contained HTML context file. This command is the HTML-format counterpart to `buildcontext`, which creates Markdown context files (see [buildcontext](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.1-buildcontext)). The resulting HTML file contains all project files with syntax highlighting, a visual directory tree, and embedded styling for easy viewing in web browsers.

For reconstructing projects from HTML context files, see [reconstructorhtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.2.2-reconstructorhtml). For converting between formats, see [md2html](/ray0404/Contexter/5.4.2-md2html) and [html2md](/ray0404/Contexter/5.4.3-html2md).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md30](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L30-L30) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L49-L49)

### Basic Usagesvg image

### Arguments and Optionssvg image

| Argument/Option | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output_file` | String | Yes | Path for the output HTML file (e.g., `project.html`) |
| `paths` | String(s) | Yes | One or more file or directory paths to include in the context |
| `--exclude` | String | No | Exclusion pattern(s). Can be specified multiple times. Added to default exclusions. |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py12-16](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L12-L16)

## Overviewsvg image

The `buildcontexthtml` command performs the following operations:

1. **Scans** the specified paths (files and/or directories)
2. **Filters** content using exclusion patterns (default patterns + user-specified)
3. **Generates** a visual directory tree structure
4. **Detects** and handles binary files appropriately
5. **Collects** all text file contents
6. **Constructs** a single HTML file with embedded styling and syntax highlighting

The key difference from `buildcontext` is the output format: HTML provides richer styling, collapsible sections, and browser-based viewing, while Markdown is more portable and text-editor friendly.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py11-58](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L11-L58) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md30](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L30-L30)

### Binary File Detectionsvg image

Binary files are detected using the `is_binary()` function from `contexter_utils` and stored with `None` as their content:

This allows binary files to be listed in the HTML output but marked as non-reconstructable.

## Output Generationsvg image

### HTML Construction Processsvg image

The final HTML file is generated by calling `rebuild_html_constructor()` with three key inputs:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `output_file` | String | Destination path for HTML file |
| `files_to_include` | Dict[str, str|None] | Mapping of file paths to contents (or None for binary) |
| `tree_content` | String | Visual directory tree structure |

**Key Features of Generated HTML:**

- Embedded CSS for styling
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks
- Collapsible file sections
- Visual directory tree
- Binary file indicators

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L57-L57) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py8](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L8-L8) (imported function)

## Usage Examplessvg image

### Example 1: Package Single Directorysvg image

Creates `myproject.html` containing all files from the `./src` directory.

### Example 2: Package Multiple Pathssvg image

Includes contents from `src` directory, `tests` directory, and the `README.md` file.

### Example 3: With Custom Exclusionssvg image

Excludes files matching `*.log` or `temp_*` patterns in addition to default exclusions.

### Example 4: Entire Project Rootsvg image

Packages the entire current directory (respecting default exclusions like `.git`, `__pycache__`, etc.).

The command builds a dictionary (`files_to_include`) mapping file paths to content:

**Data Structure:**

### Directory Walkingsvg image

Directory traversal uses `os.walk()` with top-down processing and in-place directory filtering:

The `topdown=True` parameter allows in-place modification of `dirs[:]` to control descent, and both directories and files are sorted for consistent output.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py34-48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L34-L48)

1. **Missing paths:** Warns and skips [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py25-26](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L25-L26)

## Comparison: buildcontexthtml vs buildcontextsvg image

| Aspect | buildcontexthtml | buildcontext |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Output Format | HTML with embedded CSS | Markdown with code fences |
| Viewing | Web browser | Text editor / Markdown viewer |
| Syntax Highlighting | Built-in (rendered) | Via code fences (viewer-dependent) |
| File Size | Larger (includes styling) | Smaller (plain text) |
| Portability | Requires browser | Universal text format |
| AI Integration | Limited | Full support (see [sanitizecontext](/ray0404/Contexter/5.4.1-sanitizecontext)) |
| Reconstruction | Via [reconstructorhtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.2.2-reconstructorhtml) | Via [reconstructor](/ray0404/Contexter/5.2.1-reconstructor) |

Both commands share the same core logic for file collection, exclusion patterns, and binary detection, differing only in output generation.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py1-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L1-L61) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md24-31](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L24-L31)

## Console Output and User Feedbacksvg image

The command provides verbose console output during processing:

| Emoji | Message Type | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 📂 | Directory processing | `📂 Processing directory: ./src` |
| ✅ | File successfully processed | `✅ Processed: src/main.py` |
| ⚫ | Binary file skipped | `⚫ Skipping (binary): image.png` |
| ⚠️ | Warning (path not found) | `⚠️ Warning: Path not found, skipping: ./missing` |
| ❌ | Error reading file | `❌ Error reading file src/file.py: [error details]` |
| 🎉 | Success completion | `🎉 Success! HTML context file created at 'output.html'.` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py25-58](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L25-L58)
